description.value: Livia is a family-run Italian bakery, café, and wine bar on Vancouver's beloved Commercial Drive, founded by husband-and-wife duo Claire Livia Lassam and Jordan Pires and named after Claire's grandmother. The shop serves handmade sourdough, Italian-leaning brunch and lunch, boutique Italian wines, cocktails, and handmade pasta. Evening pop-up events (including a Friday Lasagna and Lambrusco night) and private buyouts make it a destination as well as a daytime stop.
